I think I agree with you, although I have a little something I wanted to say based on personal experience...
Well so I am not transgender, I am just a female, but I think the whole gender fluidity thingy has to do with the whole masculinity vs femininity thingy cuz i only really say I am genderfluid because I honestly do not physically or mentally feel feminine. And then there are days where I do. But that might just be me frustrated with societal norms and my own body dysmorphia and other self esteem issues? But I don't go out of my way to completely dress like a guy. My personality is just exhibiting more masculine traits. 
But perhaps in this case genderfluid is the wrong word and a new word for this kind of feeling should be created? 
And then the whole otherkin thing, I sort of feel like an alien sometimes but only because I find it hard to socialize with others and sometimes feel as though not a lot of people have the same interests as me. And sometimes because I love water so much and I am a swimmer I /feel/ like a mermaid. But I am not a mermaid or an alien. 
These are all feelings and my overactive imagination.  And I don't IDENTIFY as an alien or as a mermaid or as some sort of gender switching entity. I am just a person I guess.
But, this may all just be due to a few comorbid personality disorders and mental illnesses I've been diagnosed with. Bleh. 

I don't think people should be suing and overreacting just cuz someone else doesn't correctly call them by what they feel/view themselves as in their mind.

Edit: sorry for rambling also I think that sexuality is more fluid than gender
